title: PickerField
description: Shared field + value-help popover of the Fiori date and time pickers (value states, F4 / Alt+Arrow keys).

usage.summary: Compose a custom text field and picker with caller-owned value rules.
useWhen: Let users type a custom value or choose it from a caller-supplied picker surface.
Provide the picker content, text parsing and commit rules in the application.
Supply value, open, onTextChange, onCommit and onOpenChange together with an icon and accessible picker labels.

avoidWhen.when: Use built-in localized date, range, date-time or time parsing and selection.
Enter a plain single-line value without opening a picker.
